[[DeFoe]] realized that the Huntik group would research the journal, so he had his group of [[Suits]] find the largest Foundation-run library in Venice. This was so that he could locate the team and then retrieve the book, not to mention to defeat Dante. [[Dante Vale]], [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Santiago]], and [[Cherit]] go there to research the [[Amulet of Will]] and they ended up being led to [[Metagolem]] and [[Jodis Lore]]. DeFoe, [[Grier]], and a plethora of [[Suits]] attacked them here, only to be defeated. But, in the battle, Sophie dropped a book that also led [[the Organization]] to Metagolem as well. {{source|The Casterwill Client}}

The '''Venice Huntik Library''' was built by the [[Huntik Foundation]] to house a portion of their books having to do with [[Seekers]], [[Titans]], and magic.

== History ==
[[DeFoe]] realized that the Huntik group would research the journal, so he had his group of [[Suits]] find the largest Foundation-run library in Venice. This was so that he could locate the team and then retrieve the book, not to mention to defeat Dante. [[Dante Vale]], [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Santiago]], and [[Cherit]] go there to research the [[Amulet of Will]] and they ended up being led to [[Metagolem]] and [[Jodis Lore]]. DeFoe, [[Grier]], and a plethora of [[Suits]] attacked them here, only to be defeated. But, in the battle, Sophie dropped a book that also led [[the Organization]] to Metagolem as well. {{source|The Casterwill Client}}
